topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: Well now, word’s come that old Elsbeth’s house passed to her grand-children, Jon and Elsie. It’s only right, considering how they tended to her in her last years, the way the seasons turn and the land gives its yield. I knew Elsbeth when she was a young lass, full of the vigor of spring. Now, her garden’s bound to thrive once more. Jon’s got hands for the plow and Elsie’s as gentle as the first light of dawn, no doubt the homestead will see good days yet. The village speaks kindly of the gift she’s left them, a shelter from the rains and the long, cold nights. It’s a fine blessing, one that’s earned through patience and labor, much like the harvests we draw from the soil year after year.
